title: Dreamy Tps Debugger
description: Help server owners to see info about their server!
body:
# Tps Debugger

## What does this plugin add?

Tps Debugger is a useful and lightweight plugin designed to help server owners monitor performance in real time. It displays a clean and organized sidebar with important server statistics, making it easier to identify lag or performance issues quickly.

**Displayed information:**

- TPS (Ticks Per Second)
- MSPT (Milliseconds Per Tick)
- RAM usage
- Player Ping
- Online Players
- Average Ping

![How the plugin works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b3bdb85195bc6e1432c2ec0093277636a99f6a3_0.webp)

How to use?
Simply use the command /tpsdebug to toggle the sidebar on or off whenever you need!
